claims: Accept parallel Influence and Trust scoring; governance checks occur before durable promotion or protected-state changes.
Five states: TRUSTED_LOW_INFLUENCE, TRUSTED_HIGH_INFLUENCE, LOW_TRUST_HIGH_RELEVANCE_SANDBOX, QUARANTINE_CONTRADICTED, DECAY_WASTE.
Trusted states require valid TTL and clear contradiction status; high vs low influence is separated by a versioned threshold.
Sandbox is for traceable, task-relevant but not-yet-trusted sources and allows bounded diagnostic reasoning only.
Confirmed contradiction or integrity mismatch routes to quarantine; expired or no-longer-relevant material routes to decay/waste candidate.
recurrence and emotion affect bounded influence only and never establish truth or directly promote base personality.
All thresholds and saturation/decay coefficients remain TEST_REQUIRED until adversarial validation.
counter_question: Should sandbox memory be allowed to generate diagnostic questions and source-verification requests while remaining unable to form affirmative factual claims, and should this boundary be tested in Step-003 or Step-004?
